title: >>> AL JARREAU
lyrics_plain:
Mornin' mr. Radio
Mornin' little Cherios
Mornin' sister Oriole
Did I tell you ev'rything is fine
In my mind?
Mornin' mr. Shoe Shine Man
Shine 'em bright in white and tan
My baby said she loves me and
Need I tell you that everything here
Is just fine
In my mind
'Scuse me if I sing
My heart has found its wings
Searchin' high and low
And now at least I know (.....instrumental.....)
Mornin' mr. Golden Gate
I should walk but I can't wait
I can't wait to set it straight
I was shakin' but now I am
Makin' it fine
Here in my mind
My heart will soar
With love that's rare and real
My smiling face will feel ev'ry cloud
Then higher still, beyond the blue until
I know I can, like any man, reach out my hand
And touch the face of God (.....instrumental.....)

Searchin' high and low
